name: turn-flash
description: Rapid alternating left/right turns in Lamplight Line and Duneglide. Fails when the world canvas is a single colour for 3 or more consecutive samples after the game has started.

sampling.method: drawImage the canvas into a 48x32 2D canvas (nearest neighbour; for WebGL2 sample inside the same rAF as the draw or use preserveDrawingBuffer) and read the RGBA data; a frame is SOLID when every texel is within 3 per channel of the first texel
sampling.cameraSource: window.__lamplight / window.__duneglide QA hooks (look().camera, qa camera) if present, otherwise app.camera.presented()

assert.onFailure: save the 5 frames before and after the first solid sample plus the camera pose log, then repeat the same run with ?portable=0, ?depth=standard and (Lamplight) ?fx=nobloom,nodof to bisect
